text: Could you make a video of a paper boat drifting slowly across a pond? I’ve had a busy week, and the idea of watching something that simple feels really calming. I mean an 8-second widescreen video, with the camera fixed in place the whole time. The scene should have soft morning light. Please keep it silent, with no text.
